title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
slides: Can US export controls catch what chips already left?
New rules now target remote access, not just hardware
Cloud providers must verify foreign users' identities
Companies routing through third countries face new audits
Test one partner's compliance before your next renewal
thread_text:
1. The chips are already gone

Export controls chase hardware that has already left. New rules now target remote access, not just physical shipments.

2. Remote access is the new front

Cloud providers must verify foreign users' identities. That means logging every session, not just tracking boxes.

3. Third countries under scrutiny

Companies routing through intermediaries face new audits. Compliance now depends on where your traffic goes, not where your office is.

4. Your partner's risk is yours

If your cloud provider fails verification, your renewal could be denied. Test one partner's compliance before your next renewal.

5. One test before renewal

Ask your cloud provider for their foreign user verification policy. If they can't produce it, you're exposed.
